title: Test first: the router records each sortie's decision as hops with a reason code
goal: Every routed sortie stores the path it took and a reason code per hop, when decided
acceptance: Failing tests first: a sortie stores request, pilot, role, route, model and one reason code per hop (cloud enabled for this role, cheapest passing model, local because budget used up, local because data category denied, Casper always local, fallback after a measured failure)
Reasons are recorded at decision time, never recomputed from current config; a join test across the router, F-155 selector and F-156 budget
No prompt or private text in the stored decision
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no keys, tokens, personal data or real Grover readings in Git.
escalation: Any run of a real model or a cloud call needs the owner's yes first
A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-27 from the code paths read for this plan. Not a measurement.
